title: OpenAI Says ChatGPT Search Volume Is Now Roughly 20% of Google's
summary:
The search crawler used by OpenAI processed a volume of requests equal to 18% of Googlebot's activity in October, according to web traffic monitoring. This increase in indexing is part of a broader rise in the AI company's search capabilities; OpenAI believes its internal data now shows that search-like queries on ChatGPT have reached about 20% of the volume managed by Google.

The growth in web crawling activity began accelerating in August, with weekly tracking figures rising from a range of 5.3% to 7.5% in July to a peak of 21.2% in October. In a statement to a reporter, OpenAI noted that it believes its share of search traffic is expanding quickly.
